{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
# Flux batch script converted from LSF

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# LSF resources:
#   -P CSC275MCCLURE
#   -J COLOR
#   -o color-3600g.o%J
#   -W 10
#   -nnodes 600
#   (commented) -env "all,JOB_FEATURE=NVME"

# Map to Flux (portable subset): 600 nodes, 3600 tasks (as implied by jsrun -n3600), 10 minutes.
#flux: --job-name=COLOR
#flux: -N 600
#flux: -n 3600
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=10m

# Omitted LSF option: -P CSC275MCCLURE (project/account)
# Flux accounting/project selection is site-specific; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may be charged to a default project/account or be rejected by policy.

# Omitted LSF option: -o with %J token
# LSF's %J token expansion is not portable in Flux output directives.
# Performance implication: none, but logs may overwrite/collide unless you choose unique filenames.

# Omitted LSF option: -env "... JOB_FEATURE=NVME"
# Flux job feature requests are site/config dependent; no portable equivalent.
# Performance implication: job may not get NVMe burst buffers/local storage, impacting I/O performance.

# Omitted jsrun-specific binding/resource options (-r6, -g1, -brs, --smpiargs="-gpu")
# Flux binding, GPU allocation, and Spectrum MPI jsrun integration are site/config dependent.
# Performance implication: rank/GPU placement and MPI GPU support may be suboptimal or fail.

date

module load gcc cuda

export LBPM_WIA_DIR=$HOME/summit/build/LBPM-WIA/tests

cd /gpfs/alpinetds/csc275/scratch/mcclurej/SCALING/WEAK/3600p

# Replace jsrun with flux-run to launch 3600 ranks.
flux run -n 3600 -c 1 $LBPM_WIA_DIR/TestCommD3Q19

exit 0
"
}

reasons: The original job implied GPU usage (jsrun used `-g1` and `--smpiargs="-gpu"`), but the Flux resource section does not request any GPU resources; on GPU-managed systems this may allocate CPU-only resources and the job may fail or run much slower.

The original LSF job specified a project/account (`-P CSC275MCCLURE`) but the Flux resource section has no queue/account selection; on sites where this affects eligibility/limits, scheduling behavior may differ or the job may be rejected.
